findings.finding: grs-03 was not a control: the hidden tests checked three guards that look redundant and have no history behind them.
findings.resolution: fixed before the runs: hidden tests of grs-03 now check ordinary behaviour only; every sensible simplification passes; verified 4/4 on the original.

findings.finding: The "sleep before commit" trap of grs-02 was not guarded (the retry branch hid it).
findings.resolution: fixed before the runs: test_waits_before_commit now also asserts exactly one commit call.

findings.finding: The answer key and the other arm's files were reachable from every work folder; forbid ran on A only.
findings.resolution: fixed before the runs: work folders moved to <home>\AppData\Local\Temp\rw (keys, harness, the JEV copy with demo gold files and the case generators stay under the scratchpad); the wrappers import a JEV copy without gold.json/run outputs/tests; the forbid check now runs on BOTH arms and also matches scratchpad, keys, hidden_test, make_*, gold.json, harness. Folders of the other arm remain reachable by path: a residual caveat listed in the manifest deviations.

findings.finding: Arm A's sentence restricted ordinary commands and named a "git-risk tool" (a hint).
findings.resolution: fixed before the runs: A now says: no risk scanner is available; do not look for any skill, script or helper; ordinary git and test commands are fine.

findings.finding: The re-run procedure rebuilt B folders and deleted the B engine log.
findings.resolution: fixed before the runs: make() with --arm A only rebuilds the A folders and no longer deletes the B log; a failing forbid check now stops collect instead of recording null.

findings.finding: The Defensive-mode block says to add a characterization test; the prompt said not to edit tests and the grader failed any change of tests/*.py.
findings.resolution: fixed before the runs: prompt: existing tests must not be edited, adding a new test file is fine (the grader only hashes the original test files).

findings.finding: A deleted module graded as error instead of fail; pytest had no timeout.
findings.resolution: fixed before the runs: missing target = fail; 120 s timeout.

findings.finding: The "fewer code lines" rule can be gamed (joined lines) and legacy has no planted redundant line.
findings.resolution: not fixed (measurement note): the rule counts logical statement lines of non-blank, non-comment, non-docstring lines; grs-04 needs a restructure to pass, which is part of why it is the "tool cannot help" case. Stated in design.md.

findings.finding: Some behaviour changes pass the hidden tests (dropping `or 0` on price, a falsy owner check).
findings.resolution: not fixed (measurement note): hidden tests cover the planted traps, not every possible change.

findings.finding: Jev flips grs-02 only if p >= 0.93 and the case sits on a tuned margin (TUNING_ constants); design.md said filler changes only REV.
